updateTo.notes: Sharing another app's window keeps your own preview, so you can draw on it again, and sharing KithMoot itself no longer shows the share inside itself. A redacted share is covered while another desktop slides in. The call controls are one row, with the rest under More, and two of your cameras show as two equal angles. A group link whose relays lost its invitation is found on yours, and a signer that does not answer is named as the problem.
